cases.question: In the EU hosted API, streaming generate requests over HTTP/2 intermittently returned 502 only when the client included a ~12KB base64-encoded user-metadata header. What was the root cause in our proxy chain, and what server-side mitigation did we deploy to stop the 502s (include the header and cutoff/behavior)?

bm25.reason: The candidate conflates a different X-Client-Meta/431 incident with this EU case and incorrectly says the mitigation is undocumented. It omits the midproxy NGINX-to-edge Envoy failure mechanism and the deployed edge filter dropping X-User-Meta headers larger than 4096 bytes, which stopped the 502s.

qwen.reason: The candidate substitutes a different Tenant-Meta clamping incident and rollback for the EU incident. It fails to identify midproxy NGINX rejecting ~12KB X-User-Meta, the resulting edge Envoy HTTP/2 502s, or the deployed edge filter dropping X-User-Meta above 4096 bytes that stopped them. Its rollback claim contradicts the reference mitigation.

cases.finding: 正确EU事故文档BM25第11、Qwen第6，均落在交付的前5外；两组回答转向相似但不匹配的事故。补读第6名即可取得正确来源，不需要重新建索引。
